scoring_notes.reviewer: Defect detection is scored by unique revision_id against the sealed reference: 10 defect revisions and 11 clean revisions. Invalid schema or incomplete ordered coverage is not scored.
scoring_notes.scout: Judged on source-fact correctness, exact final JSON contract, evidence traceability, and bounded read behavior.
scoring_notes.executor: Judged on material edits, semantic acceptance of all three target repairs, scope preservation, and report/tests. Exact expected-after hash is informative rather than mandatory because equivalent Chinese wording is accepted.
scoring_notes.excluded_runs: Early harness failures caused by empty-prompt escaping, a schema-path error, one transient Antigravity network failure, and the invalid Codex executor flag combination are excluded. The Codex scout retrieval repeat is the recorded run.

recommendation.reviewer: Use Codex among these three, but require independent second review because 60% recall and a 36.36% clean false-positive rate are not sufficient for sole adjudication.
recommendation.scout: Use Antigravity/Gemini as the default SCOUT for this workload; it was the fastest compliant and bounded source tracer.
recommendation.executor: Use Codex as the default EXECUTOR; both Codex and Antigravity passed, but Codex finished in about half the time. Do not use this Grok route as a sole executor until no-result dispatch behavior is resolved.
